title: 4.10 What Time Is It?
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Ask What time is it?, say whole-hour times, and say the afternoon and night parts of the day.
grammar_function: What time is it? It is + number + o'clock. in the morning / in the afternoon / at night; at + time.
prerequisite: 4.5 wake up and morning; 4.8 study; 4.9 day question; Unit 3 numbers.
speaking_outcome: Ask the time and say whole-hour times and parts of the day.
